Name: Oranje-Blanje-Blou
Author: Gembleton
Description:
My first foray into modding something that isn't Morrowind or one of Paradox's Grand Strategy games, this is just for me to get used to how this game works - as much as I love Stardew, I've never tried to mod it, before. Since I have a big interest in history, I thought I'd use the old flag of my homeland.

In the (all too likely) event that I've made a huge blunder in making this, a PM with suggestions would be much appreciated.
